meaning: extremely ugly or revolting to look at; repulsive in a way that causes disgust or fear.
nuance: Hideous carries moral or visceral repulsion, not just plainness. It suggests something so wrong or wrong-looking that it disturbs you—a hideous crime is morally offensive; a hideous scar is visually shocking.

confusables.difference: ugly just means unattractive; hideous means intensely repulsive or morally wrong as well
grotesque is oddly deformed or absurdly exaggerated; hideous is simply revolting

examples: He had a hideous scar running down his face that made people stare.
The scandal revealed hideous corruption at every level of the government.
memory_hook: Sounds like 'hide us'—so ugly you want to hide from it.
